title: Photopatterning Proteins and Cells in Aqueous Environment Using TiO2 Photocatalysis
protocol: Number the coverslips using a diamond scriber.
Clean the coverslips under running ddH2O.
Immerse the coverslips in piranha solution (H2SO4:H2O2 = 4:1) for 10 min.
Rinse the coverslips thoroughly, 8 times in ddH2O.
Dry the coverslips under N2 flow.
Set TiO2 target in the radio-frequency (RF) sputtering system.
Attach the coverslips onto a sample holder using polyimide tape.
Place the sample holder in the sputtering chamber.
Evacuate the chamber until pressure reaches 2.0×10-4 Pa.
Introduce Ar gas into the chamber and set deposition pressure to 4.0 mTorr.
Gradually increase RF power to 70 W with shutter closed.
Open the shutter and sputter for 15 min.
Hydrophilize the TiO2 surface by treating the sample with O2 plasma for 5 min at 200 W with O2 flow of 100 sccm.
Immerse the sample in ddH2O to confirm superhydrophilic surface.
Dry the surface thoroughly under N2 flow.
Prepare 1 mM octadecyltrichlorosilane (OTS) solution by adding 39.6 μl OTS to 100 ml toluene.
Immerse the sample in the OTS solution for 1 hr at room temperature inside an N2-filled glove bag.
Sonicate the sample in toluene, acetone, ethanol, and ddH2O for 5 min each.
Rinse the sample four times in fresh ddH2O.
Dry the surface under N2 flow.
Sterilize the OTS-coated TiO2 by immersing the sample in 70% ethanol for 5 min.
Rinse the sample twice in sterilized ddH2O.
Place the sample in a 35-mm dish and add 2 ml of PC12 growth medium.
Incubate for over 3 hr in a CO2 incubator at 37°C.
Wet the surface of a 60-mm tissue-culture dish with ddH2O and aspirate all ddH2O.
Prepare 300 μg ml-1 Col-IV by diluting the original solution (3 mg ml-1) 10x with ddH2O.
Add 200 μl of 300 μg ml-1 Col-IV per 60-mm dish and let the solution spread through the surface.
Dry the dish in a laminar flow hood for approximately 1 hr.
Rinse the surface twice with 4 ml of Dulbecco's phosphate-buffered saline (D-PBS).
When not using the coated dish immediately, rinse the dish once with 4 ml of ddH2O.
Aspirate ddH2O and store the dish in the incubator.
Passage PC12 cells before they reach confluence.
Incubate PC12 cells in a CO2 incubator (37 °C, 5% CO2).
Replace half of the medium every other day for routine culture.
Aspirate the growth medium from PC12 cells.
Add 2 ml of PBS+ (D-PBS + 10 mg/ml bovine serum albumin (BSA) + 10 mM EDTA) prewarmed to 37 °C.
Incubate for 5 min at 37 °C.
Gently tap the dish to detach all cells.
Collect cells in a 15 ml conical tube.
Rinse the dish with 3 ml of fresh D-PBS, prewarmed to 37 °C.
Centrifuge the tube at 150 × g for 4 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and add 1 ml of growth medium.
Split cells 1:3 to 1:5 for routine culture.
Count cell density and add 3.0×105 cells in a 35-mm dish.
Incubate the dish in the humidified incubator at 37 °C with 5% CO2 for 1-2 days.
Add 100 ng/ml of 7S-NGF to the growth medium several days before plating for NGF differentiation.
Confirm that cells are attaching and growing only on the UV-irradiated region after 1-2 days of culture.
Set up the microscope as described in Step 3.4.
Transfer the sample to a new 35-mm tissue culture dish containing the growth medium, 100 ng/ml NGF (for NGF-differentiated cells), and 100 μg/ml Col-IV.
Place the dish on the microscope stage.
Find the appropriate position and irradiate UV light at a dose of 200 J/cm².
Transfer the sample back into the medium without Col-IV after irradiation.
Be extremely careful when carrying the dish with cultured cells.
Transfer the sample from dish to dish carefully to prevent detaching of patterned cells.
